notes.title: Demo Available + Next Fest!
notes.content:
Greetings Bandits and Trappers,

Ahead of the upcoming Next Fest, we've gone ahead and turned on the Bandit Trap demo! Hop in and check out the tutorials for both bandits+trappers, play against bots, Online, or play against a group of your friends! 

We've updated the demo as well:

 Updated in-game EULA.
 Lots of improvements to player climbing system.
  Fixed an issue causing bots to get stuck when attempting to navigate to certain targets.
 Fixed a rare issue causing bots to get stuck when attempting to use the grinder weapon.
 Fixed an issue causing bots to make incorrect judgements while using the VR scanner.
 UX / UI improvements
 Quality of Life improvements.
